description: This file defines utility functions for handling and type guarding different binding types (AgentBinding, AgentRouteBinding, AgentAcpBinding) within a configuration object in a TypeScript project related to OpenClaw. It includes functions to normalize binding types, filter bindings by type, and list bindings from configuration.

methods.name: function normalizeBindingType(binding: AgentBinding): "route" | "acp" { normalizeBindingType
methods.description: Normalizes the type of an AgentBinding to either 'route' or 'acp'.

methods.name: export function isRouteBinding(binding: AgentBinding): binding is AgentRouteBinding { isRouteBinding
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an AgentBinding is an AgentRouteBinding.

methods.name: export function isAcpBinding(binding: AgentBinding): binding is AgentAcpBinding { isAcpBinding
methods.description: Type guard that checks if an AgentBinding is an AgentAcpBinding.

methods.name: export function listConfiguredBindings(cfg: OpenClawConfig): AgentBinding[] { listConfiguredBindings
methods.description: Returns an array of AgentBindings from the configuration, defaulting to an empty array if none are present.

methods.name: export function listRouteBindings(cfg: OpenClawConfig): AgentRouteBinding[] { listRouteBindings
methods.description: Filters the configured bindings to return only route bindings.

methods.name: export function listAcpBindings(cfg: OpenClawConfig): AgentAcpBinding[] { listAcpBindings
methods.description: Filters the configured bindings to return only ACP bindings.

ctags.name: isAcpBinding
ctags.pattern: /^export function isAcpBinding(binding: AgentBinding): binding is AgentAcpBinding {$/

ctags.name: isRouteBinding
ctags.pattern: /^export function isRouteBinding(binding: AgentBinding): binding is AgentRouteBinding {$/
